name: Scholarship to SC students studying in selected schools under Talentpool Scheme
benefit: 1. Financial assistance of up to ₹40,000/- per student is provided.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste. 1. The applicant should from Standard 5 and Standard 10. 1. The applicant should be studying in a school selected under the Talent Pool Scheme. 1. The applicant's parents' income limit should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. (whose income is between ₹2,00,000/- and ₹3,00,000/-, are eligible for 50% assistance). 1. The applicant must be a student.
